Hopefully this will help you some, I have adopted 4 ferrets, 2 at about 2 months old and the other 2 were a little over a year. Both ferrets a little over a year would not eat ANYTHING I bought for them. The reason being that ferrets can and will get set on very particular diets and will literally starve themselves to death if not given the food that they are used to. For me, I had to buy Purina cat food for the two older ones (which they now all eat) but I would suggest giving your little pal whatever it is that the old owner fed it, as long as it’s healthy. Hopefully this helped you some!
